title: Lobetyolin, a Q-marker isolated from Radix Platycodi, exerts protective effects on cisplatin-induced cytotoxicity in HEK293 cells.
authors: Hou, Yun-Yi; Qi, Si-Min; Leng, Jing; Shen, Qiong; Tang, Shan; Zhang, Jing-Tian; Hu, Jun-Nan; Jiang, Shuang; Li, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Lobetyolin对顺铂肾毒性的保护作用，仅含小分子-蛋白对接（NF-kB），非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigated the protective effect of lobetyolin (LBT), a Q-marker isolated from the roots of Platycodon grandiflorum (Radix Platycodi), against cisplatin-induced cytotoxicity in human embryonic kidney (HEK293) cells. Results showed that LBT at 20 muM significantly prevented cisplatin-induced cytotoxicity by improving the viability of HEK293 cells, decreasing levels of MDA, and decreasing GSH content triggered by cisplatin. It also suppressed reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. Molecular docking analysis revealed a strong binding affinity between LBT and the NF-kappaB protein, with a docking fraction of - 6.5 kcal/mol. These results provide compelling evidence suggesting a potential link between the visualization analysis of LBT and its protective mechanism, specifically implicating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. LBT also reduced the expression level of tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), phosphorylation NF-kappaB and IkappaBalpha in HEK293 cells which were increased by cisplatin exposure, leading to inhibition of inflammation. Furthermore, western blotting showed that LBT antagonized the up-regulation of Bax, cleaved caspase 3, 8, and 9 expression and inhibited the MAPK signaling pathway by down-regulating phosphorylation JNK, ERK, and p38, partially ameliorating cisplatin-induced cytotoxicity in HEK293 cells. Therefore, these results indicate that LBT has potentially protected renal function by inhibiting inflammation and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了桔梗根（Radix Plycodi）中分离的Q标记物桔梗皂苷D（lobetyolin, LBT）对顺铂诱导的人胚肾（HEK293）细胞毒性的保护作用。结果表明，20 μM的LBT通过提高HEK293细胞活力、降低MDA水平及减少顺铂引发的GSH含量，显著预防了顺铂诱导的细胞毒性。同时，它还抑制了活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）水平。分子对接分析显示，LBT与NF-kappaB蛋白之间具有强结合亲和力，对接分数为-6.5 kcal/mol。这些结果提供了有力证据，表明LBT的可视化分析与其保护机制之间存在潜在联系，具体涉及NF-kappaB信号通路。LBT还降低了HEK293细胞中由顺铂暴露升高的肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）表达水平以及磷酸化NF-kappaB和IkappaBalpha的水平，从而抑制炎症反应。此外，Western blotting显示，LBT拮抗了Bax、cleaved caspase 3、8和9表达的上调，并通过下调磷酸化JNK、ERK和p38抑制了MAPK信号通路，部分改善了顺铂诱导的HEK293细胞毒性。因此，这些结果表明，LBT可能通过抑制炎症和凋亡来保护肾功能。
